faqs.q: What is a Demco DM 7500 3″ gate for?
faqs.a: A 3″ DM 7500 gate is the sliding closure in Demco DM 7500 mud gate valves rated 7,500 psi, which shuts off against the seat. It is alloy steel, usually black QPQ-nitrided, and is supplied new in the Cameron (Demco) or interchangeable form.

faqs.q: What is the Cameron part number for the 3″ DM 7500 gate?
faqs.a: The Cameron part number for the 3″ DM 7500 gate is 2171112-01. DM 7500 gates carry seven-digit numbers like this one, so read the stamp on your old gate to match. Quote the number on the RFQ and say if you need OEM or interchangeable.

faqs.q: Which valve does the Demco DM 7500 3″ gate fit?
faqs.a: It fits 3″ Demco DM mud gate valves in the DM 7500 series only. A DM 7500 gate does not fit a DM 2000–5000 valve, or the other way round. The minimum bore through a 3″ DM 7500 valve, the wear ring ID, is 2.98 in.

faqs.q: What material and finish does the Demco DM 7500 3″ gate have?
faqs.a: The listing gives alloy steel, black finish, with steel black finish and steel bright finish gates also listed. faqs.q: What should I replace together with the Demco DM 7500 3″ gate?
faqs.a: Replace the seat insert with the gate, because the gate and seat wear as a pair and a new gate against a worn seat rarely holds. See the [3″ DM 7500 seat insert](/p/demco-dm-7500-gate-valve-seat-insert-3-inch) and the [3″ repair kit](/p/demco-dm-7500-gate-valve-repair-kit-3-inch), and fit a new bonnet seal whenever the bonnet has been off.
